name: Challenge: Rejected co-draw invite preserves saved identity, both strokes and Undo
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /studio.
Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Rename the project to Challenge guest original using the project-name control and confirm with Enter.
Select the Pen tool.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
Click Save drawing.
Verify the save status says Changes saved.
Open Studio options, then Co-Draw session.
Choose Join Session in the Peer-to-Peer Co-Draw dialog.
Enter invalid-invite in Host invite code input.
Click Save My Drawing & Join Separately.
Verify a readable invalid-token or invalid-format error appears and no Generated answer token is produced.
Click Close in the Co-Draw dialog.
Verify the project is still Challenge guest original, with both original strokes unchanged and no shared artwork substituted.
Click Undo.
Verify only the lower-right vertical stroke disappears; the upper-left horizontal stroke remains unchanged.
Click Redo.
Verify both strokes exist with transparent space between them; remember their positions and shapes for later comparisons.
Click Save drawing.
Verify the save status says Changes saved.
Reload this page.
Verify restoration completes and Challenge guest original still contains both strokes in their original positions.
Open File, then Projects.
Verify Challenge guest original is available in Projects and the rejected invite has not created a Shared Drawing project.
